top_signals.title: Software Stocks Get an Earnings Gut Check After Hot Summer Rally
top_signals.summary: Software investors are betting that the struggling stocks have found their footing again after a strong performance over the past month. Earnings this week can confirm that this latest rally has staying power.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China’s IPO Rush Is Showing Strain With Pace Nearing 2023 Frenzy
top_signals.summary: China’s high-powered market for initial public offerings is showing signs that its breakneck pace could be difficult to sustain.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: India to Transfer Missile Technology to Domestic Manufacturers
top_signals.summary: India on Tuesday approved the transfer of technology for all conventional missile systems developed by its state-run defense research agency to domestic manufacturers, allowing them to produce the weapons locally.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Major Indian Supermarket Chain Plans Record Rupee Bond Sale
top_signals.summary: Avenue Supermarts Ltd., a leading Indian supermarket operator, plans to raise up to 10 billion rupees ($105 million) through a domestic bond offering, according to people familiar with the matter, its largest ever as corporate debt sales in the country gain momentum.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Galaxy puts Coldcard hack losses at 1,789 BTC, with 87% unmoved
top_signals.summary: Galaxy Research’s latest tally shows that more than half of 221 Coldcard hack victim reports involved individual losses exceeding 1 Bitcoin.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Dutch Navy to equip fleet with Destinus C-UAS interceptor drones
top_signals.summary: The Royal Netherlands Navy plans to equip its fleet with a new counter-UAS capability from defense firm Destinus.
